Start with failed_attempts=locked_until=last_seen=0. Reject now earlier than last_seen with 200. Reject LoginSucceeded (120) or LoginFailed (121) before locked_until with 201. Reject AdminUnlock (122) without admin with 202. Successful login clears failed_attempts and advances last_seen. LoginFailed commits failure 203: the third consecutive failure clears failed_attempts, sets locked_until=now+900, and alerts security-team (channel 300, kind 150, deadline); other failures increment failed_attempts. Authorized unlock clears count and deadline and sends kind 151 with deadline zero. Every commit sets last_seen=now; otherwise preserve fields and reject without effects.
